name: CRE24
source: CRE benchmark problems (Tanabe & Ishibuchi, 2020). 8 constrained multi-objective problems with explicit constraints. Sign convention --------------- The CRE problems are defined for **minimization**. BoCoDe **maximizes**, so every ``_evaluate_implementation`` here returns ``-fx`` (the negated original objectives) and ``ref_point`` is the negated reference point.
